comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Travelers can book the same lodging stays on Airbnb instead of upscale select-service hotel rooms; business and leisure travelers overlap.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Sells hotel room stays to leisure travelers; a hotel guest can book a room at its Reno resort instead.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Operates hotel rooms sold directly to leisure guests; a lodging customer could book a room there instead.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Owns hotels alongside casinos; travelers can book hotel rooms there as an alternative lodging option.

note: Only lodging-selling candidates qualify; other REITs and restaurants serve different buyers or products, and casino hotels are weaker alternatives.
